record.title: China’s 2030 national informatization plan sets AI research and intelligent-internet priorities
record.summary: On 23 October 2026, China’s Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission issued its Fifteenth Five-Year National Informatization Plan. The Cyberspace Administration of China’s official release and Q&A describe a national 2030 programme with 12 indicators, 10 task areas and seven action columns, including intelligent-internet infrastructure, AI-enabled research and development, foundation-model and collective-intelligence research, industrial application, AI skills and safety governance. These are plan objectives and government statements; the linked full plan PDF was inaccessible during this review, and implementation, appropriations, infrastructure delivery and measured outcomes were not established.
organizations: Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission of China

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: The Cyberspace Administration of China published an announcement on 23 October 2026 that the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission had issued the Fifteenth Five-Year National Informatization Plan.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: The official Q&A describes 12 indicators, 10 task areas and seven action columns for the plan’s 2030 horizon, including intelligent-internet development, AI-enabled scientific research and technology development, foundation-model and collective-intelligence research, AI-related industrial application and safety governance.

claims.label: NOT_ESTABLISHED
claims.text: The inspected announcement and Q&A do not establish that the plan’s investments or infrastructure have been funded or delivered, or that its AI research, adoption, productivity or safety objectives have been achieved.

evidence_gaps.description: The linked official Chinese plan PDF could not be accessed in this review; details beyond the CAC announcement and Q&A remain uninspected.
The announcement does not establish implementation, appropriations, infrastructure delivery or measured AI outcomes.

brief.importance_rationale: If implemented as described, a national 2030 plan coordinating information infrastructure, AI research and industrial application could materially shape China’s research and deployment environment. This score reflects the scope of stated objectives, not confidence that they will be delivered.
limitations: The full plan PDF was linked by CAC but inaccessible to the web reader; this account is bounded to the official release and Q&A.
The stated objectives and targets are official policy claims, not evidence of delivery or impact.
No implementation notice, budget document, deployment measure or independent evaluation was reviewed.

technical.strongest_baseline: The prior national informatization plan and existing AI, information-infrastructure and industrial policies; no matched implementation or outcome comparison was made.

brief.title: China’s 2030 national informatization plan sets AI research and intelligent-internet priorities
brief.why_it_matters: The plan places AI research, intelligent-internet infrastructure and industrial deployment inside a broad national information strategy with a 2030 horizon. If carried through, it could shape research priorities, infrastructure and adoption conditions in China. The release establishes the plan’s publication and stated objectives, not implementation or technical results.
